items.title: 6.6.1 Evolving Technologies in Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Cloud computing nayi technologies ke saath aage barh rahi hai jo is ki capabilities (kya kya kar sakti hai) aur istemal barhati hain, aur ise zyada efficient (kam waqt aur kharche mein achha kaam karne wala), scalable aur accessible (aasani se milne wali) banati hain. Agle do topics aisi do technologies batate hain: edge computing aur serverless architectures.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein cloud ki kaun si do nayi technologies aati hain?

items: Nayi cloud technologies: edge computing aur serverless architectures.
